question: What result follows from abstaining from eating during the day?
premises: Age-death is named as the object
A future going or passing is stated
inference: By abstaining from eating during the day, one will go beyond age and death
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with vayo mṛtyuṃ is contextually read as overcoming or passing beyond age-death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome age and death.
